title: OpenRE-Bench: A Benchmark Harness for Multi-Agent Requirements Engineering with Mined GitHub Issues
abstract: arXiv:2611.13925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: OpenRE-Bench is an open-source benchmarking infrastructure for large language model (LLM) based multi-agent requirements-engineering (RE) frameworks. Such frameworks are increasingly common, but they use different agent roles, negotiation policies, and output shapes, and are typically evaluated on their own runtimes, metrics, and small sets of curated system descriptions, which makes fair, reproducible comparison difficult. OpenRE-Bench addresses this with four reusable pieces: a shared run harness with one input, phase-artifact, and metric contract; an adapter mechanism through which a framework joins by implementing a single adapter, leaving cases, metrics, and other adapters untouched; a reproducible GitHub issue-mining pipeline that grows the corpus from real feature requests; and a versioned case suite. As a demonstration, we mine 3,000 fetched issues across five projects (three languages, five domains) into five cases, package them

translated_title: OpenRE-Bench：一个基于挖掘GitHub议题的多智能体需求工程基准测试框架
translated_abstract: OpenRE-Bench 是一个开源的基准测试基础设施，面向基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体需求工程（RE）框架。这类框架日益普遍，但它们使用不同的智能体角色、协商策略和输出形式，并且通常在各自自建的运行时环境、评估指标和少量精选的系统描述集上进行评估，这使得公平、可复现的比较变得困难。OpenRE-Bench 通过四个可复用的组件来解决这一问题：一个具有统一输入、阶段产物和指标契约的共享运行框架；一种适配器机制，使框架只需实现单个适配器即可接入，而无需改动用例、指标及其他适配器；一条可复现的 GitHub 议题挖掘流水线，用于从真实的功能请求中扩充语料库；以及一个版本化的用例套件。作为演示，我们从五个项目（涵盖三种语言、五个领域）中挖掘了 3,000 个获取的议题，形成五个用例并对其进行打包。
tldr: OpenRE-Bench 通过共享运行框架、单适配器接入机制、可复现的GitHub议题挖掘流水线和版本化用例套件，实现了对基于LLM的多智能体需求工程框架的公平、可复现的基准测试比较。
en_tdlr: OpenRE-Bench enables fair, reproducible benchmarking of LLM-based multi-agent requirements engineering frameworks through a shared run harness, a single-adapter mechanism, a reproducible GitHub issue-mining pipeline, and a versioned case suite.
